headline: No scored news; lines drift as stories fade
body: A quiet weekend day with no scored events. Earlier announcements faded a little, shaving hundredths off Reversion and Self-Destruction. The lower reading left by Friday's GPT-5.6 cheating report and gated preview stays largely in place, with no new events to push it either way. Horizon Balance held at +0.56.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Reversion and Self-Destruction shifted most, by two hundredths, from fading contributions.
